title: Allotropes
description: Molecular allotropes as complete drawings. Polymeric red phosphorus and plastic sulfur are not templates. Singlet and triplet oxygen are two Lewis drawings of O2, not two PubChem compounds.

entries.name: Singlet oxygen
entries.description: Closed-shell Lewis drawing of O2 (PubChem CID 977, molecular oxygen). Singlet vs triplet is an electronic state; this SMILES is not a second PubChem compound. Name-search 'singlet oxygen' resolves to atomic oxygen and must not be used.

entries.name: Triplet oxygen
entries.description: Diradical Lewis drawing of ground-state O2. No PubChem CID. Full Lewis structure and the lone-pair overlay refuse unpaired electrons on a main-group atom; insert is educational.

entries.name: Tetraphosphorus
entries.description: White phosphorus P4. PubChem CID 123286 (name tetraphosphorus). The 'white phosphorus' hit CID 5462309 is atomic P and must not be used.
